{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''Elba Squadron''' was a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in service of the [[Dimok government]]. It took part in the [[Raid on the Tropsobor]] against an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] shipment of [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s, but failed largely due to the efforts of [[TIE pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
